hints.title: Degree Parity Analysis
hints.text: Only nodes with odd degrees need their parity changed. By the handshaking lemma, the number of odd-degree nodes is even.

hints.title: Odd Count Constraints
hints.text: Adding at most 2 edges can resolve at most 4 odd-degree nodes. If the count of odd nodes is not 0, 2, or 4, it is impossible.

hints.title: Exhaustive Case Handling
hints.text: For count 2, try connecting the two directly, or connecting both to a mutual non-neighbor. For count 4, check the 3 possible disjoint edge pairings.

hints.title: Parity Correction Verification Implementation

complexity.notes: Constructing adjacency hash sets and checking constant number of node pair cases.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all pairs of potential edge additions takes O(V^4).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) memory for adjacency sets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that at most two added edges can only fix 0, 2, or 4 odd degree vertices and handles all pairing scenarios.
